findings:
🟠 [r5-final-panel-coverage] MUST-FIX The final-panel fixture sets min_panel_size to 1 and asserts final_panel_count is 1, so the rejected second seat does not exercise the specified panel-blocking path; it also checks only that the successful seat lacks raw_log, not that its digest is byte-identical to base. This leaves required quorum-failure and digest-preservation behavior unpinned. Set the sealed minimum to 2, assert the panel blocks with the failed seat excluded, and compare the successful seat’s shape/digest against a fixed base expectation.
🟡 [r8-red-provenance] MUST-FIX The new salvage assertions in review-runner.test.sh and raw_log/schema assertions in implementation-campaign-receipt.test.sh lack the required RED-at-base block headers with observed base behavior, while the semicolon preservation assertion is not labelled as a preservation guard. This fails rubric R8’s mandatory provenance contract; add the specified RED and preservation annotations to those assertion blocks.
